jobs.description:
Do you have experience working with HR systems and master data processes, and would you like to help shape JYSK’s future HCM platform? Are you motivated to play a central role in the implementation of our new HCM solution across JYSK countries? Then this could be your next opportunity at JYSK Head office in Aarhus.

As HCM System Specialist, you will join the agile Human Capital Management team and act as a subject matter expert within HR systems and processes. You will work closely with colleagues in Payroll, HR and IT across JYSK countries, helping to optimise existing solutions while supporting the implementation of new systems and processes. The role combines system expertise, stakeholder collaboration, testing, training and continuous improvement in an international environment.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, your attitude, commitment and willingness to learn are valued. You will become part of an experienced and supportive team where knowledge sharing, collaboration and development are part of everyday work. As we continue our digital transformation journey within HR, you will have the opportunity to influence solutions used across the organisation and contribute to projects with significant business impact.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A key role in one of the largest initiatives currently taking place in JYSK helping shape future HR processes and technology globally in JYSK

• The chance to contribute to the continued development and support of our HR systems across 30 JYSK countries impacting more than 38.000 employees in JYSK

• The opportunity to participate in and lead selected HCM projects

• Close collaboration with HR, Payroll and IT stakeholders across the business

• A workplace where responsibility and trust go hand in hand

• Professional and personal development opportunities in an international company

• An agile working environment focused on continuous improvement

• Strong teams, knowledge sharing and a supportive culture

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting and improving HCM processes and systems across the organisation. You will help ensure stable operations while contributing to future system developments, process design and overall requirement management. You will act as the link between business needs and technical solutions and play a key role in ensuring quality through testing, training and stakeholder collaboration.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Subject matter expert support on and optimisation of SAP HR and HR master data processes

• Drive and take part in the implementation of global HCM templates ensuring scalable and standardised solutions across countries

• Translating business requirements into functional specifications for IT teams

• Supporting implementation activities across countries

• Participating in and leading selected HCM projects and rollouts

• Planning, coordinating and executing testing activities for new HCM solutions

• Delivering user support, training sessions and knowledge-sharing activities

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for someone who enjoys combining system knowledge with collaboration and problem-solving. You are structured in your approach, comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and motivated by improving processes and solutions that create value across the business.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has 3-5 years of experience working with HCM systems, e.g. SAP SuccessFactors or SAP HR

• Holds a bachelor's degree within HR, Organisation, Business Administration or a related field, or has equivalent experience from Payroll or HR Support

• Has experience with system implementation, process development or digital transformation initiatives

• Has worked with system testing, user support and training activities

• Communicates clearly and can translate business needs into technical requirements

• Builds strong relationships with stakeholders across functions and countries

• Thrives in an agile environment and takes responsibility for delivering high-quality results

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Sustainability & Total Rewards Director, Ditte Revsbæk Hansen at +45 3050 8125.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

Do you want to have an influence on home furnishing trends across multiple countries? As Head of Range and Design at JYSK, you will define how our products look, feel and work together – from sleep and furniture to textiles and home décor.

You will own the vision and direction for JYSK’s overall product universe, establishing the design DNA that connects our products across categories. By translating our brand, trends, customer insights and commercial ambitions into a clear design direction and compelling collections, you will make it easier for customers to create an affordable Scandinavian home.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will join an international retail company with high ambitions, short decision-making processes and a strong focus on results. Based at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus, Denmark, you will work closely with colleagues across the organisation to turn creative ideas into products that reach customers across countries.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A strategic leadership role with significant influence on JYSK’s design direction, product universe and customer experience

• Leadership responsibility for a dedicated three-person team, with opportunities to develop the team

• Close involvement in product development, supplier partnerships and emerging home furnishing trends

• A cross-functional working environment where creative ideas are balanced with customer needs and commercial objectives

• A results-oriented culture built on trust, teamwork and freedom with responsibility

• A straightforward working environment where ideas can quickly become action

• Opportunities for professional and personal development, along with attractive employee benefits

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Head of Range and Design, you will own and develop JYSK’s overall design direction and collection architecture across product categories. You will ensure that our Scandinavian design DNA is reflected consistently in our collections, with colours, materials, shapes, functionality, quality and packaging working together to create a recognisable customer experience. Balancing creative ambition with customer insights and commercial priorities, you will turn the design vision into compelling, commercially successful products.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Developing collection architecture and design briefs in close collaboration with Category Management and suppliers

• Using customer insights, sales data and profitability to guide design decisions and strengthen range performance

• Presenting design concepts and recommendations to stakeholders, aligning creative ideas with commercial priorities

• Collaborating with Marketing, E-Commerce, Visual Merchandising and Sales & Expansion on photography, social media, campaigns and the overall customer experience

Besides the above, you will lead and develop the three-person Design team, setting clear priorities, providing constructive feedback and fostering a culture of creative excellence, collaboration and commercial awareness. You will participate in range meetings, trade fairs and supplier visits in Denmark and abroad, travelling approximately 30–40 days per year to stay up to date with emerging trends and bring new inspiration into JYSK.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a colleague who combines a strong design vision with commercial understanding and the ability to translate creative ideas into successful products across a broad product range.

Ideally, you bring:

• Solid experience in design, product development, range management or category management within an international retail, brand or lifestyle business, with a strong track record of developing product concepts or collections

• The ability to define a clear design direction and translate it into practical design briefs and priorities

• A strong understanding of Scandinavian design, including colours, materials, functionality and visual consistency

• A data-driven approach to decision-making, using customer insights, sales data and profitability to guide design choices

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build relationships and create alignment across functions

• Experience in leading and developing colleagues, setting clear priorities and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous development

• Fluency in English and confidence in presenting design concepts and recommendations to different stakeholders

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact EVP Purchasing, Martin Amstrup Bang at +45 2540 8402.

We encourage you to attach a portfolio showcasing relevant design work, collections, concepts or projects that demonstrate your design approach and experience. The portfolio can be uploaded together with your CV or shared via a link in your application.

Are you motivated by supporting agile teams, driving digital progress, and enabling high-quality deliveries in a collaborative and structured environment?

If so, this could be your next opportunity to join JYSK and be part of an international retail success story.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, you will join a fast-paced and forward-thinking organisation that values growth, continuous improvement, and professional development.

You will become part of Available to Promise (ATP) and Flow of Goods Execution (FEX), two agile teams in Purchasing ART (Agile Release Train) with a clear mission: ensuring reliable product availability and efficient flow of goods from suppliers to stores and customers. Together with business specialists, developers, and stakeholders, the teams drive digital solutions and continuous improvements that strengthen supply chain processes including order fulfillment, supplier collaboration, and inventory processes, supporting seamless operations from suppliers to stores and customers.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• 
a supportive and collaborative culture where learning and knowledge sharing are part of daily work

• 
a workplace in an exciting international company where results, expansion and development have a high priority

• 
the opportunity to work closely with other IT Delivery Leads in the ART and through our Community of Practice

• 
an organization with short decision paths and high levels of autonomy

• 
close cooperation with stakeholders across all levels of the organization

• 
a workplace that values work-life balance and employee wellbeing

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As an IT Delivery Lead at JYSK, you drive successful delivery across iterations and ensure the team can achieve its PI (Program Increment) commitments. You create clarity and focus by strengthening agile ways of working, ensuring transparent data, and removing obstacles that block progress. With a strong delivery mindset, you coordinate dependencies across teams, foster predictable and disciplined execution, and enable fact‑based decisions. Your leadership helps secure flow, stability, and business value -building a healthy, well-functioning, and high-performing team.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• 
Drive planning and coordination to secure steady progress and strong delivery outcomes

• 
Remove obstacles and enable the team to reach its goals with confidence

• 
Lead and facilitate agile events that strengthen flow, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• 
Indirect leadership and coaching of the team in agile methods and principles to ensure high‑quality deliveries

• 
Foster change management through open communication, collaboration, and proactive handling of risks, dependencies, and issues

• 
Partner closely with Product Owners, IT Delivery Managers, Line Managers, and stakeholders across JYSK and ARTs

• 
Drive and implement IT delivery initiatives together with key stakeholders to improve ways of working

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• 
has 5+ years of experience in driving digital deliveries to meet objective, quality and timeline, either from a role within IT project management/Scrum Master or software development.

• 
has strong interpersonal skills and actively contributes to team motivation and engagement

• 
works in a pragmatic, structured, goal-oriented way and adapts easily to changing priorities

• 
communicates clearly and confidently with a variety of stakeholders

• 
has strong problem-solving abilities, challenges constructively and proactively removes blockers to team progress

• 
have experience with facilitating agile events and workshops effectively

• 
is experienced in agile practices, methodologies, and frameworks, such as Scrum, Kanban, and/or SAFe

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

**The Impact You'll Make

**As a Senior Data Engineer - AI & Databricks , you will help shape how AI is adopted across Danfoss Climate Solutions, especially within our global sales organization.

Working as part of a global team of data, analytics, and AI professionals, you will build and evolve a trusted, scalable, and well-governed Databricks platform that enables sales teams across multiple regions and functions to turn data into actionable insights. Your work will support use cases such as sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and customer insights, helping teams make faster, data-driven decisions.

By ensuring the platform is secure, high-quality, and continuously improving, you will enable reliable data products and Generative AI solutions that drive business value. Working closely with data engineers, analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders, you will help establish best practices and scale AI adoption across the organization.

Success in this role means delivering trusted, AI-ready data products that strengthen governance, accelerate AI adoption, and support better business decisions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and improve Databricks governance, including Unity Catalog, data access, security, and data quality

• Design and maintain scalable data architecture, ensuring best practices across data models, tables, and pipelines

• Enhance Genie spaces (AI-powered knowledge tools) by improving content, entity matching, and answer quality for end users

• Partner with cross-functional teams to enable adoption of data products and AI solutions that support data-driven sales decisions

• Evaluate and implement new Databricks and AI capabilities to improve platform performance and deliver measurable business value

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Azure Synapse), including Unity Catalog and data governance practices

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with hands-on experience building scalable data models and modern ETL pipelines

• Proven ability to design and manage data platforms that enable analytics or AI use cases in a business environment

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders, translating data and AI capabilities into practical business solutions

• Fluent in English, with strong communication skills and a proactive interest in applying emerging AI technologies

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• Shape how AI is applied across global sales teams, driving measurable improvements in forecasting, pipeline visibility, and customer insights

• Work hands-on with Databricks, Unity Catalog, and Generative AI to build solutions used across multiple markets

• Influence how data and AI solutions are scaled globally, working with diverse teams and stakeholders

• Grow in a collaborative and international environment that supports continuous learning, innovation, and career development

• A competitive compensation package and flexible hybrid working model, with access to global opportunities

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you’re excited about building data platforms that power real-world AI applications and drive business decisions, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and explore how your work can shape the future of AI at Danfoss.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Job Description

**We at Danske Bank connect global markets and help businesses grow. As Head of Guarantees, you will lead our guarantee teams across the Nordics, shaping the strategic direction of our business that sits at the heart of our Trade and Working Capital Solutions offering.

**What You Will Be Doing

**This is an opportunity to combine deep financial expertise with people leadership and digital innovation. You will join the Trade and Working Capital Solutions department, reporting to the Co-head and working within a matrix organisation that spans countries and functions. The team is collaborative and commercially minded, with a shared commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality service to clients. You will partner closely with teams across the organization and represent the guarantees business in internal forums and external industry discussions.

More specifically, you will:

• Set and execute the strategic direction for the guarantees business across the Nordics

• Lead the transformation of guarantee processes using AI, digitalisation and automation

• Develop and grow the guarantee teams, building capabilities and a clear succession pipeline

• Partner with sales and advisory teams to deliver guarantee solutions that meet client needs

• Ensure all activities comply with legal, regulatory and internal governance requirements

• Use business and service measures to identify improvements and build operational resilience

**About You

**

• Degree in finance, economics, business or a related discipline

• Comprehensive knowledge of banking and global trade

• Demonstrated experience leading and developing specialist teams

• Strong understanding of AI, digitalisation and their responsible application in banking

• Comfortable working across countries and functions in a matrix organisation

• Clear commercial judgement with sound risk management awareness

• Professional fluency in English and at least one Nordic language

Familiarity with relevant legal and regulatory frameworks across multiple Nordic markets is an advantage. Experience with succession planning and talent development would also be a welcome addition, supporting you in your transformational leadership role.

**What We Offer You

**This is an opportunity to shape the future of Danske Bank’s guarantees business across the Nordics and lead its transformation. You will be offered a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, in addition to real opportunities for professional growth and development. Working alongside knowledgeable and supportive colleagues, you will spend three to four days per week in the office whilst we offer you the flexibility to work in a way that fits your life. This position can be based on our modern offices in any Nordic country.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this role sounds like the right fit for you, we would be glad to hear from you. To apply, please send your CV and cover letter via our recruitment system by November 11th, 2026.

For questions about the role, please reach out to hiring manager Jukka Kuusala at jukka.kuusala@danskebank.fi or +358 (0)50 336 6476. Jukka is best available on November 2nd at 13-15 (CET) and November 6th at 13-15 (CET).

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Data Portfolio Analyst for Markets Data Office
jobs.description:
Bring your banking and data experience into our newly established Markets Data Office. Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

About the job

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, influence how we work and make a real impact on how data is governed at scale.

What you will do

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will take ownership of data governance activities within one of our four domain areas. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams to improve how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices, while also helping to define and improve these as the team develops.

Your responsibilities will include

• Taking ownership of ongoing data governance activities within your domain and driving them forward

• Identifying and documenting Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data attributes with stakeholders, assessing which are critical for Saxo and driving the governance of Critical Data Elements (CDEs)

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and lead root cause investigations

• Defining and maintaining data definitions, rules, thresholds and documentation used in monitoring and control activities

• Monitoring data quality outputs, tracking remediation and escalating when issues are not being resolved

• Building strong working relationships with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Helping shape the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain, helping create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who you are

You bring:

• Some years of experience from the banking sector, which is a requirement for this position

• Experience in data analysis, data quality, data governance or a related field

• The ability to understand data in the context of business processes and explain your findings clearly to both business and technical audiences

• The ability to produce clear and structured documentation

• Hands on experience with SQL. Experience with Python is an advantage

• Experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

It would be a clear advantage if you have

• Experience from Markets functions such as trading, market or counterparty risk, investment products or operations, including an understanding of how a trade moves from front to back

• Experience with data governance in financial services, for example CDEs, data ownership, data profiling, data controls, data lineage or BCBS 239

• Experience with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar data platforms and data quality tools

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build trust with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You can manage changing priorities, bring structure to areas that are still developing and help shape solutions as the team grows.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

What we offer

• The opportunity to help build a new data function and its foundations from the ground up

• Real ownership and influence on how critical data is governed across Markets

• Exposure to key business domains and critical data flows

• The opportunity to work closely with experienced colleagues across Markets, data and technology

• A role that can develop alongside a growing team

You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, giving you the opportunity to take on new challenges, grow your responsibility and influence how critical data is managed across Markets.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: Sr. Director, Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead world-class expertise at the front of differentiating peptide and protein drug discovery? Do you want to impact the drug discovery strategy that helps new candidates move faster, more reliably and with stronger scientific confidence towards first human dose?

If so, this is a unique opportunity to advance molecular expression, bioanalysis and ADME science, accelerate drug innovation for people living with serious chronic diseases, and champion technological innovation and collaboration across boundaries to deliver exceptional performance across discovery and development.

**The Position

**As Sr. Director for Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME, you will lead two centres of excellence and set the direction for the area that enables novel peptide and protein candidates to move quickly and reliably towards first human dose (FHD). Your leadership will enhance molecular expression, PK and ADME science, safeguard critical timelines and strengthen the competitiveness of the discovery portfolio.

You will provide senior leadership for the Centre for Expression Engineering and the Centre for Bioanalysis & ADME, shaping strategy and delivery across the area. You will partner closely with Research Centres of Excellence (RCE), Therapeutic Discovery, Chemistry Manufacturing and Control (CMC), Global Research, Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS), CROs and academic and biotech collaborators to keep projects progressing with clarity, quality and speed.

You will lead a team of Department Managers and Scientific Directors and, together with them, guide a high-performing, purpose-driven team of around 80 colleagues in total. As a member of the RCE leadership team, you will help move decisions forward and shaping the culture, represent the area in steering committees and sponsor initiatives that improve business outcomes and collaboration.

Location: Måløv, Denmark.

**What You’ll Do

**You will:

• Set and implement the strategic and operational direction for EEBA so new lead drug candidates enter FHD with competitive, de-risked molecular expression, PK and ADME profiles.

• Oversee core deliverables in molecular microbial expression, bioanalysis, PK and ADME for the protein and peptide research portfolio and cross-area strategic projects.

• Own operational efficiency and capacity management, prioritising the FHD critical path activities and aligning mitigations with key stakeholders.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration across Research, CMC/GMS and external partners, acting as a key liaison to keep projects progressing.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and ethical standards and support the digital strategy through robust data management and AI applications.

• Drive the team to set benchmark for world-class expertise and operational excellence, building and sustaining the capabilities needed to deliver on portfolio ambitions and strategic priorities.

• Inspire and empower department managers and teams through visionary leadership and meaningful mentorship, nurturing talent and creating opportunities for people to grow, thrive and succeed together.

• Build a high-capability, high-performance, challenge-safe and collaborative culture through role-modelling, talent development, succession planning and continuous efficiency improvements.

• Identify and sponsor cross-organisational initiatives that improve business outcomes, collaboration and research impact.

**What You’ll Bring

**This is a senior leadership role in pharmaceutical drug discovery. To succeed, you will bring:

• A PhD in Life Sciences, Pharmacology, Molecular Biology, or a related field.

• At least 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical and/or biotech research, including drug discovery and preclinical development.

• Proven experience leading leaders and managing cross-functional, high-performing research teams and strategic tasks.

• A track record of creating research and business results with impact at a senior level.

• Strong understanding of early drug research, complemented by broader knowledge of the drug development value chain, including clinical development, CMC and manufacturing methods

• Strong collaborative leadership, enterprise and pragmatic mindset and the ability to build partnerships across disciplines and with external partners.

• Decisiveness in complex, uncertain research settings, with clear communication to executives, teams and external partners.

• High ethical standards and a commitment to developing research talent and future leaders.

• Experience applying AI and machine learning to optimise discovery and development.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will lead outstanding scientific expertise at the front of peptide and protein drug discovery, with the trust to make decisions, set direction and shape how the area works. You will grow through cross-portfolio learning, senior collaboration and the chance to influence strategy across Research & Development. Given the strong scientific expertise already embedded across the organization, direct experience in all technical disciplines is not essential. Instead, we are seeking a leader who excels at leading and motivating people, collaborates across boundaries, and puts enterprise priorities first—with a solid understanding of the drug R&D value chain and significant leadership experience in early drug discovery, biotechnology, or the pharmaceutical industry.

The work moves at pace, combining scientific ambition with a strong performance culture where your contribution is recognised.

You will be part of a collaborative high-performing leadership team where people keep things informal, find creative solutions together and have fun along the way.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead the science that gets competitive new drug candidates to patients faster, apply for the Sr. Director, EEBA role by 8 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

About the job

We are looking for an experienced Video Editor / Photographer to join our in-house creative team for a six-month maternity cover starting in December. The main focus of the role is on video production and editing.

The position is located in our modern Global HQ office in Hellerup. As a Video Editor in the creative team, you will report directly to the Head of Design & Production. You will be responsible for creating video content using in-house resources and agency-produced campaign materials. Your tasks will also include planning and shooting smaller productions, such as financial-analysis talking heads, as well as handling editing, colour grading, sound, and effects through to final delivery. Photography is a secondary part of the role, which will include taking employee portraits and capturing photos of internal events. Major campaign video shoots and still photography are produced with external agencies.

The ideal candidate combines strong editing and storytelling skills with hands-on filming experience. As well as the ability to independently deliver polished video content across various channels.

In this role, you will get the opportunity to work in a hands-on video production role within a global scope. As well as have creative ownership on a variety of assignments. You will work alongside collaborative and highly skilled colleagues in a team that values creativity, ownership, and professional growth.

Responsibilities

• Plan and shoot smaller video productions using in-house resources, such as financial-analysis talking heads and expert interviews, managing cameras, lighting, and sound recording

• Create engaging social media content from in-house footage and agency-produced campaign materials, shaping stories, pacing, and visual flow from initial assembly to final cut

• Complete video post-production, including colour correction and grading, sound editing and mixing, motion graphics, visual effects, and sub-titling

• Edit agency-produced campaign footage into cutdowns and localised versions, adapting aspect ratios, subtitles, graphics, and audio for different channels and markets

• Collaborate with creative, marketing, and compliance stakeholders, incorporating feedback and ensuring brand consistency and production quality

• Manage footage, project files, version control, and final exports, meeting technical specifications and production deadlines

• Photograph employees and internal events, including image selection and retouching

• Coordinate with agencies when supporting major campaign still photography

Your profile

• 5+ years of experience in video production and editing, ideally within a creative agency, production company, or an in-house team

• A strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, filming, editing, and polished post-production across commercial and social content

• Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with working knowledge of After Effects for motion graphics and visual effects

• Hands-on experience filming smaller productions, including talking heads, with camera operation, lighting, and sound, colour grading, audio finishing, and export workflows

• Ability to deliver video content using in-house resources and agency footage, photography skills for employee portraits and events, including Photoshop or Lightroom

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still very much in the build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

Who are you?

We are six colleagues including you, working closely together in a direct, hands-on and informal way. Orifarm has a flat structure and short paths to decision-makers.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of making affordable medicine accessible.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

**Shaping Our Ai Capabilities

**Are you motivated by building the platform that powers a company's AI ambitions, alongside a team of highly skilled and similarly motivated engineers? Then you may just be the perfect fit for our Cloud Platform team in STARK Group IT.

We are at the early stages of establishing an AI Center of Excellence in partnership with the CTO Office, and our Platform team is building the infrastructure capabilities needed to support it, from hosting AI agents to enabling on-prem AI workloads. This is an opportunity to help shape those capabilities as they evolve.

**The mission, should you choose to accept it

**As our new Senior Platform Engineer, you will join our existing cloud team, taking responsibility for applying modern cloud disciplines and technologies to design and implement the Cloud Platform used by more than 17 development teams and powering solutions for our 20,000 global employees. Increasingly, that also means helping shape how AI is used across the company - working hand in hand with the CTO's office as they build out the AI Center of Excellence, contributing to what "good" looks like for agentic usage, cost and credit management, agent scaling, and building the platform capabilities that make it all work in practice.

This isn't just an infrastructure role. You'll help define guidance and best practices alongside the CoE, as well as build the platform underneath it - a rare chance to shape both the standards and the systems from the ground up. You'll become part of a highly performant, international team that gives you plenty of freedom in how you work, along with responsibility to make your own impact.

Your work with us will primarily, but not exclusively, revolve around the following areas:

• Expand our Azure Cloud capabilities, leaning on IaC as your main tool and following the principles of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.

Lead global customer success and drive commercial growth across some of the world’s most influential media organizations.

Do you thrive at the intersection of customer success, commercial leadership, and strategic relationship management? Are you motivated by developing existing enterprise customers through complex solution sales while acting as a hands-on leader for an international team?

On behalf of Stibo DX, we are seeking an experienced Vice President, Customer Success RoW to lead customer success activities across Rest of World markets and play a central role in the company’s continued transformation towards a SaaS and recurring revenue business model. RoW includes several strategically important markets for Stibo DX, including Denmark, the Netherlands, India, and other key markets across Europe and Asia-Pacific.

The Opportunity

As Vice President, Customer Success RoW, you will be responsible for driving customer retention, adoption, value realization, and commercial growth across Stibo DX’s global customer portfolio outside the DACH region and the Americas. This is a commercial leadership role focused on developing existing enterprise customers through complex, value-based solution sales. The role combines strategic account leadership, executive stakeholder management, commercial ownership, and people leadership of three people, and you will act as a hands-on player-coach for the team.

Based in Denmark, from either their headquarters in Aarhus or their Copenhagen office, you will report directly to the Senior Vice President, Customer Success Management.

You will lead the RoW Customer Success organization and be part of the global Customer Success leadership team alongside the regional leaders for DACH and the Americas.

You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Professional Services, Support, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Executive Management to ensure customers maximize the value of their investment in the Cue Media Enterprise Platform while supporting Stibo DX’s ambitious growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities

As Vice President, Customer Success RoW, you will lead and further develop customer success across a strategically important international region that includes Denmark, the Netherlands, India, and other key markets across Europe and Asia-Pacific. You will support existing customers through complex business and technology transformations while driving commercial expansion across the portfolio. Your responsibilities will include:

• Owning Customer Success performance across the RoW region, including retention, Net Revenue Retention, adoption, customer health, and commercial growth within the existing customer portfolio.

• Leading and developing an international Customer Success team as a hands-on player-coach while creating a high-performance culture focused on measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

• Building trusted executive-level relationships with strategic customers and personally leading selected key customer engagements and complex commercial opportunities.

• Driving customer value realization and supporting customers in maximizing business impact from the Cue platform while identifying opportunities to expand Stibo DX’s solutions across their organizations.

• Identifying and managing customer risks and growth opportunities while balancing long-term customer success with commercial objectives and driving complex, value-based solution sales.

• Contributing actively to the global Customer Success leadership team and helping shape best practices, processes, and strategic priorities across regions.

The Ideal Candidate

You are an experienced and commercially minded customer-facing leader with a proven track record from Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Enterprise Sales, Professional Services, Consulting, or a similar function within B2B software and SaaS environments.

You understand what it takes to build long-term strategic customer relationships and create sustainable growth within an existing customer portfolio. You are comfortable shaping and driving complex commercial opportunities, engaging new stakeholders within customer organizations, and leading value-based solution sales from initial opportunity through negotiation and agreement. At the same time, you are a capable people leader who enjoys acting as a hands-on player-coach, developing the team and creating momentum around complex customer opportunities.

You bring credibility in executive-level dialogues and are comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across customer organizations as well as internally across functions and geographies. You combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on and distinctly commercial approach and are known for your ability to build trust, create alignment, and execute consistently.

Experience from subscription-based software businesses, SaaS transformations, or enterprise technology environments will be highly advantageous. Exposure to structured commercial methodologies such as MEDDPICC is considered a strong plus. Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities are considered beneficial, but not essential.

Why Join Stibo DX?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible leadership role at a company investing significantly in future growth, innovation, and product development. You will have direct influence on customer outcomes, revenue retention, and expansion across some of the world’s leading media organizations, combining people leadership with hands-on involvement in complex commercial projects.

You will join a global technology company with deep industry expertise, a strong financial foundation, and a long-term ownership model that enables continued investment in customers, people, and products.

As part of the global Customer Success leadership team, you will help shape how Stibo DX engages with customers worldwide while contributing to the company’s continued transition towards a SaaS-first business model. The role offers extensive international exposure across a strategically important RoW portfolio, including Denmark, the Netherlands, India, and other markets across Europe and Asia-Pacific, as well as close collaboration with colleagues across Denmark, Germany, Norway, Spain, and the USA.

Help empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Their platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world’s most ambitious and successful media organizations.

They are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Their roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports their continued growth.
